content.text: This workaround appears to be OK with gcc debug flags, but fails with --apply-default-release-flag (probably due to optimizer?).
Anyhow - this is very low priority, so will leave it for now.
Leave open just to get rid of this crap when we're far enough past gcc 7.1 that this isn't needed.
appears still needed on gcc8, on ubuntu 1810, but noticed only needed for DEBUG builds so only included there.
Still needed for g++-8 on Ubuntu 18.04, so leave this around. Maybe able to find a better way to suppress these warnings, but existing workaround is OK for this release.
/usr/arm-linux-gnueabihf/include/c++/6/debug/map.h:409:30: note: parameter passing for argument of type ‘const std::
/usr/arm-linux-gnueabihf/include/c++/6/bits/stl_map.h:944:7: note: parameter passing for argument of type ‘std::_
/usr/arm-linux-gnueabihf/include/c++/6/bits/stl_map.h:945:37: note: parameter passing for argument of type ‘std::_
NOW - this happens only with gcc 6 ARM version.
Workaround is to specify -Wno-psabi on the gcc command line.
Added  --append-compiler-warning-args -Wno-psabi to the regression test configs using gcc6 and arm.
